narrative.northStar: Made of what it's made of
narrative.overview:
The beacon is a heart of thin brass rods, joined by hand with blobs of tin solder, photographed on grey felt. The app uses those three materials and nothing else. Brass is the one accent: every control you can press, every selected state and the primary action. Tin, the solder's pale neutral grey, is the light ground. Felt, the charcoal cloth, is the dark ground and the stage the beacon stands on in both themes.

The object leads. Home opens on the beacon itself, drawn from the real build: rods, soft uneven joints, battery block, board, LEDs and wire. Everything else is quiet Material 3 on tin or felt, with section rows gathered on rounded plates. Saturated colour exists only where the firmware puts it, in the LEDs, so colour always means a mood or the battery.

Nothing moves at rest. The stage draws a frame only while an LED effect, a gesture or a transition runs.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (brass), two grounds (tin, felt), firmware LED colours as the only saturated colour.
A fixed dark felt stage in both themes; the object and its light are the picture.
Jost for names, headings, figures and buttons; the system face for reading.
Sections on rounded plates with hairlines; no shadows.
The twin shows only what the desk beacon does. Unknown is shown as unknown.

rules.name: The Firmware Colour Rule
rules.body: A saturated colour on screen is a colour the LEDs can show, and it means that mood or the battery level. No other red, amber, cyan or blue appears, except Material's error role.

rules.name: The Brass Is Pressable Rule
rules.body: Brass marks controls and selections only. Headings and facts are ink.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Battery, times, dBm, versions and step counts use tabular figures so values do not jitter.

rules.name: The Light Is Real Rule
rules.body: Glow appears only where an LED is lit, in that LED's colour. No decorative glows, no glass, no gradient text.

dos: Do keep brass for things that can be pressed or are selected.
Do take every LED colour and timing from `Fx`; show stale or missing values as stale or unknown.
Do keep the stage on dark felt in both themes, and draw frames only while something is happening.
Do group a section's rows on one plate with hairlines, heading above in Jost.
Do keep joints on the cage rounded and uneven, rods thin, highlights wide and soft.
donts: Don't add a second accent or use an LED colour for decoration.
Don't play a sent mood on the user's own heart.
Don't add shadows under plates, glass panels, gradient text, emoji icons or small labels above headings.
Don't animate the stage at rest.
